title: ProofMeta Status Update Payload
description: Payload schema for PENDING / GRANTED / DENIED / SUSPENDED / REVOKED envelopes. A status.update has exactly one of two modes (see `oneOf`): (A) a CHAINED VERDICT in a license lifecycle — carries `request_id`, and the outer envelope's in_reply_to MUST point at the previous envelope's payload_hash; or (B) a ROOT ATTESTATION — a standalone, signed policy/governance verdict that carries `subject` + `policy` and no `request_id`, with no prior request required. The first attestation about a subject is an envelope root (no in_reply_to). See PROOFMETA_ANWEISUNG.md §3.4 and docs/attestation-extension-proposal.md.

request_id.description: Mode A only. Must match the OPEN envelope's request_id. Mutually exclusive with `subject`/`policy` (enforced by oneOf).

subject.description: Mode B only. What is being judged by this attestation (e.g. an observed AI tool, asset, or action).

id.description: Stable identifier of the subject under judgement.

content_hash.description: Optional sha256 binding the verdict to a specific observed state of the subject.

host.description: Optional environment/host the subject was observed in.

policy.description: Mode B only. The rulebook this verdict was made against.

ref.description: URL and/or sha256 reference to the policy/rulebook applied.

scope.description: Conditions applied, using the scope vocabulary (core tags or extension URLs — see docs/scope-vocabulary.md).

reason.description: Required on SUSPENDED and REVOKED transitions. Human-readable cause for auditors.

note.description: Optional human-readable context for the state transition (e.g. reinstatement note).

valid_until.description: Optional signed expiry bound on GRANTED. Expiry is derived at read time from this field — not a stored lifecycle status.

delivery.description: Typically attached to GRANTED envelopes. Opaque to the protocol.

method.description: Delivery method identifier matching a Manifest 'delivery' resolver id.
